title: Kai-Ching claim stream and a Sweat key migration stop
detail: First full day without hotwallet.kaiching's batch of about 2,000,000 accounts a day, which ended about 14:18 UTC on 2026-04-01; sweat-migration.near's last batch ended about 07:16 UTC on 2026-04-02. Together they explain 99% of the fall in txns and all of the fall in active_accounts_v3. On-chain cause only: no statement from Cosmose or NEAR was found. See docs/USAGE_BREAK_2026-04-02.md

detail: vote.dao proposal 27 succeeded. The protocol config still read a 30% contract reward on 2026-11-01; check fct_protocol_config for the change taking effect

title: HSP-029 passes its on-chain vote
detail: vote.dao proposal 29 closed on 2026-11-02 with about 3.29M veNEAR for and almost none against, at 62% turnout; it read Timelock in the 2026-11-05 snapshot. fct_governance_proposals carries the live status

title: Developer gas rebate removed with protocol version 87
detail: The protocol config read contract_gas_reward_rate 0.3 and protocol version 86 on every night through 2026-11-04 and 0 with version 87 on 2026-11-05, so vote.dao proposal 27 has taken effect; gas burn is now the whole fee. See fct_protocol_config and fct_supply_daily

title: NearBlocks stops computing circulating supply
detail: Its /v1/charts and /v1/stats figure has read 1,249,836,992 NEAR since this day. Its rewrite of 2025-09-03 removed the lockup job. See docs/CIRCULATING_SUPPLY.md

title: Genesis allocations finish unlocking
detail: Month 60 after transfers were enabled, as NEAR's 2020 post planned. On the chain, lockups made in 2020 hold almost nothing from then on; 7.6M NEAR stayed locked, all but a few NEAR in lockups made later

title: NearBlocks' circulating supply endpoint starts returning total supply
detail: CoinMetrics' estimated market cap follows on 2025-10-25, because its supply reaches it from this endpoint through CoinGecko
